description: Plantage Badlaan 6-14 (BAG 1843-1858): 5.6 m fronts of ground and three upper storeys in brown-red brick; three axes of white-framed segmental windows under a corbelled brick hood, white sills (storey 2 on a green iron console), a balcony stack on the middle axis, iron wall anchors, a white cornice at 12.4-14.0 m and a pediment dormer

match.note: Badlaan 6-14: BAG dates 1843-1858 and 3DBAG eaves 14.8-14.9 (cornice top); the face pin keys it

pediment-dormer.note: one white dormer over the door-side axis

domed-dormer.note: domed (round-topped) white dormer with a finial, Badlaan 6-14 strip 2023-01-02 (lane buurt-weesper)

door-right.note: double door at the right axis

schemaLimits: the sculpted keystone heads of 44 are plain blocks
the dormer's low side cheeks are not drawn

evidence.citation: strip.jpg gridded 40 px/m: ground windows 0.5-2.75; storey-1 4.2-5.9 with a balcony 3.5-4.2; storey-2 6.9-9.0; storey-3 9.8-11.8; corbel hoods 0.4 m over each head; cornice 12.4-14.0 m

schemaLimits: the corbelled hood is drawn as an arch ring
